title: Carib Gear Pro Professional Laminate Flooring Tools Installation Kit with Tapping Block, Rubber Mallet, 44 pcs Pull Bar, and 40 pcs Spacers for Vinyl Plank, LVP, and Hardwood Laminate Floor

reviews.reviewDescription: Used on Luxury Vinyl Plank install. When I first started my overly ambitious project of changing the flooring in 4 rooms I had made my own block out of a chunk of wood and used a garden kneeling pad. Obviously not ideal, but the worst part was the struggle to tightly close the gap between planks as I was laying them which was taking the most time and mega frustrating. Finding this kit online I figured it was worth a try. ABSOLUTE GAME CHANGER. The tool they include in the kit to tighten the gap fits right on one plank and is wide and you just tap it into place, no struggling to beat it into submission over and over. That tool is the gem of the whole kit. The knee pads are good and are saving my knees from true sorrow. The mallet is more streamline that the hammer I was using and I like that each end is a different material. The tap block, if you need it is hard and notched so you don't damage the joining lip of the plank which will ruin the plank. And finally there is a tool that when pushed into an irregular edge or area will conform to that shape that you can then transfer to the plank and cut accurately. Love, love, love this kit. My only regret is that I did not have this when I first started, I'm sure I would have been much further along with the project.

Layed wooden flooring throughout hallways in house with this product. Top quality product .Had everything I needed to complete project. Great handyman kit. Will use again soon for the dining room floor.
The kit worked well. The block, mallet and pull bar were perfect. The kit did NOT contain knee pads, as stated in the description.
Great set of tools worked very well

This was my second time laying a large area of vinyl plank flooring. I dreaded it after my first experience, and thought I’d invest in this kit. I had all the right tools to make the job easier. My door jambs are cut perfectly, the seams went together without a single one cracking, and my knees didn’t end up bruised. It was the best deal for the price, the tools are high quality, and I’m not dreading doing the bathroom floor now.
